violations.name: Missing global fault handler
violations.recommendation: Implement global fault handler to ensure centralized error management.

violations.description: Runagenticreactpattern(r0) -> WhileNotDone(wh0) dependant invokes are not under fault handler for better error handling This entire flow is one indivisible business task with one common failure outcome and is not enclosed by a local TRY.
violations.name: Dependant invokes are not under fault handler
violations.impact: Failures within a logical task boundary can be harder to isolate, recover, and troubleshoot when the grouped actions are not protected by a local fault handler
violations.recommendation: Add a local fault handler around the grouped activities so failures in that task can be handled close to where they occur
